tldr: Venus in the 7th house routes love and value through one-to-one bonds.
body: With Venus in the 7th house, love, attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, harmony, and the way you receive move through partnership, marriage, clients, contracts, and open conflict. This makes how you meet others, let yourself be met, and handle equality in relationship a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, relational grace, and the ability to attract support. Left unconscious, it can become people-pleasing, indulgence, avoidance of conflict, or measuring worth by approval in this area.
gift: warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, relational grace, and the ability to attract support expressed through one-to-one bonds.
challenge: people-pleasing, indulgence, avoidance of conflict, or measuring worth by approval in this area concentrated in one-to-one bonds.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
